title: Parameterized function on the three-dimensional sign cube
statement:
For a real parameter $t$, define a function $f_t$ on sign vectors $x=(x_0,x_1,x_2)$ by
\[
f_t(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac{1}{4}x_0x_1+\frac{1}{4}x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2,
\]
where each coordinate is in $\{-1,1\}$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $3$
